    class RetryReason {

    class FatalReason {
      readonly _tag = "FatalReason"

    class AppError {
      readonly _tag = "AppError"
      constructor(readonly reason: RetryReason | FatalReason) {}
    }
    
    declare const program: Effect.Effect<string, AppError>
